answer: Pay rewards on a vesting horizon instead of instantly. Each epoch's earnings sit in escrow for, say, ten epochs before they can be spent or used to vote. If, inside that window, an account is shown to be a clone of others, its unvested nectar is forfeited and paid to the graders who flagged it. A sybil farm needs quick cash to fund more fake accounts, so making new identities wait turns spam from a safe haven into a slow, risky bet.
